What I searched (queries run against the indexed corpus):
- "arbitration seated in Singapore"
- "arbitration Singapore"
- "arbitration clause \"arbitration\""
- "\"seated in Singapore\""
- "Singapore"
- variants with kind:document / kind:paragraph filters

Result: no document was found that provides for arbitration seated in Singapore. The only arbitration clause located names London (msa-2019.pdf — p.16; cite: d2#416, p16/13) which reads, in part, "Any dispute shall be finally resolved by arbitration seated in London under the LCIA."
